consequences: Composer activates on host 0.0.21. Any host 0.1+ release requires a conscious range revisit.
context: Composer manifest declared compat.bitty >=0.5,<1.0 while the host ships 0.0.21, so the host refuses activation fail-closed and live proof is impossible (W-103 D1). Repo compat ranges are inconsistent: bar/activity/composer use >=0.5,<1.0; file-manager/git-panel/palette/statusline use >=0.1,<1.0; devtools uses >=0.0.21,<1.0.
decision_body: Pin compat.bitty to >=0.0.21,<0.1. Lower bound is the verified-against-current host version; upper bound <0.1 is restrictive on purpose because 0.x minors may break. Revisit on API bumps.
rationale: Fail-closed refusal blocks all live verification. Semver 0.x minors may contain breaking changes, so the restrictive <0.1 ceiling is deliberate; it deviates from devtools wide <1.0 ceiling by design.
title: Pin compat.bitty to >=0.0.21,<0.1 (verified-against-current)
